value: On 207 fixed-transfer-harmed wells, CASL reduces RMSE relative to Always TL on 99.0% of them (partial rescue), but the typical magnitude is modest: median improvement = 0.031 RMSE, IQR = 0.025. 91% of harmed wells improve by > 0.01 RMSE and 22% by > 0.05 RMSE; 88% improve by > 1% relative to Always TL. CASL fully beats No TL (undoes the damage) on only 38.6% of harmed wells. Interpretation: the 99% partial-rescue rate is real and consistently in the right direction, but it reflects mostly small-to-moderate error reductions (risk control / damage limitation) rather than large rescues; the headline count should be paired with these magnitudes and the lower full-rescue rate.
